# Spells

Every spell available in Inazria lives here. The [class spell lists](lists.md) say which spells each caster can reach. The description files say what each spell does.

## How to read an entry

Each description opens with a block giving the spell's level and school, casting time, range, components, and duration. Two abbreviations appear on the class lists:

- **R** marks a ritual. You can cast it as a ritual if you have the Ritual Casting feature, taking 10 minutes longer and spending no spell slot.
- **C** marks concentration. You can concentrate on only one spell at a time.

Component abbreviations are **V** for verbal, **S** for somatic, and **M** for material. A material component listed in parentheses is consumed only where the description says so.

## Spells original to Inazria

These workings were written in Alore and appear in no other game. Each carries a short passage on where it came from.

- **Cantrips.** Cusgarn Mind Trick, Extract Humidity, Guphati's Cut, Hukanu, Keldale's Bank of Ember, Tsgonji's Magic Whip, Vash Gale
- **1st.** Elemental Recoil, Karatagh Shudder, Ndaru's Rush of Speed, Rime Panoply, Shard of Senakutu, Twin Spark
- **2nd.** Blast of Snow, Vessari's Certainty
- **3rd.** Blast of Kerangala, Dramtal Upheaval
- **4th.** Asuran Greatform, Senatari Sphere of Storm, Snare of Fennveldt
- **5th.** Light of Suryakal, Pelagoran Thunderclap, Whirlpool to Zerakahm
- **7th.** Oztagh Tornado
- **8th.** Echo of Morybell
